## Rule inferred from task-1377fd69 (verified correct)

The input is a large regularly tiled grid: thick/background wall lines form rectangular rooms, and most room interiors share a single background color. Some wall-line intersections are recolored. Decode to a smaller room grid:

4. For each room, inspect the four intersections of its two bounding horizontal lines with its two bounding vertical lines. If all four corners have the same non-wall/special color, use that color for the corresponding output cell. Otherwise leave the room-interior color.

This is a 2x2 corner-consensus rule, not a sampling of one corner and not a direct copy of the special intersections.
